symbol.description: The symbol of the financial instrument (e.g., 'AAPL', 'EUR/USD', 'ETH/BTC').

interval.description: Time interval between data points. Supported values are `1min`, `5min`, `15min`, `30min`, `45min`, `1h`, `2h`, `4h`, `1day`, `1week`, `1month`.

outputsize.description: The number of data points to retrieve. Defaults to 30.

format.description: The format of the response. Can be 'csv' or 'json'. Defaults to 'json'.

function.name: earnings_history
function.description: Fetches the earnings history of a given stock ticker using the Toolbench RapidAPI.

ticker.description: The stock ticker symbol for which to fetch the earnings history.

function.name: get_litecoin_block_by_hash_or_height
function.description: Fetches detailed information about a Litecoin block by its hash or height.

hash.description: The hash or height of the Litecoin block you want to retrieve details for.

messages.content: Could you fetch the latest news in German for me, and also provide the top sports headlines in the US?

function.name: latest
function.description: Fetches the latest news from Google News for a specified language region.

lr.description: Language region to get news for, e.g., 'en-US'.

function.name: top_headlines
function.description: Fetches top headline news articles based on specified parameters.

language.description: Language code to filter news articles. Default is 'en'. Options include:

category.description: Category of news articles to filter by. Default is 'sports'. Options include:

country.description: Country code to filter news articles. Default is 'us'. Options include:

sortby.description: Criterion to sort news articles by. Default is 'published_date'.

pagesize.description: Number of news articles to return per page. Default is 10.

function.name: news_source
function.description: Fetch the latest news stories for a given news source in chronological order.

source_id.description: The identifier of the news source for which to retrieve the latest news stories.

messages.content: Get the current local time and UTC offset for the IP address 8.8.8.8.

function.name: time_zone_api
function.description: Retrieves the current local time and UTC offset hour and minute for a specified location.

q.description: Location query such as city name, coordinates, or IP address.

format.description: Desired response format, default is None.

messages.content: Find the nearest electric vehicle charging stations in New York City.

function.name: paragraph
function.description: Generates a specified amount of Lorem Ipsum paragraphs using the RapidAPI Lorem Ipsum API.

amount.description: The number of Lorem Ipsum paragraphs to generate. Defaults to 2.

function.name: nearest_stations
function.description: Return the nearest alternative fuel stations within a specified location or coordinates.

location.description: A free-form input describing the address of the location. Default is '433 Bryant St., San Francisco'.

latitude.description: The latitude of the desired location.

longitude.description: The longitude of the desired location.

radius.description: The radius (in miles) around the search location to search for stations within.

status.description: Return stations that match the given status. Options are 'all', 'E', 'P'.

access.description: The accessibility type of the stations. Options are 'all', 'public', 'private'.

fuel_type.description: The type of fuel provided by the stations. Options are 'all', 'BD', 'CNG', 'E85', 'ELEC', 'HY', 'LNG', 'LPG'. Default is 'ELEC'.

cards_accepted.description: Payment methods accepted by the stations.

owner_type.description: Type of ownership of the stations. Options include 'all', 'FG', 'LG', 'P', 'SG', 'T'.

federal_agency_id.description: Filter stations by the federal agency owner IDs.

ev_network.description: Electric charging stations belonging to specified networks.

ev_charging_level.description: Levels of electric vehicle supply equipment. Options include 'all', '1', '2', 'dc_fast'.

state.description: Return only stations within the given state. Must be provided as a two-character state code.

zip.description: Return only stations within the given ZIP code.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to return. Default is '1'.

offset.description: Offset the results found to paginate the results.

function.name: get_vehicle_models
function.description: Fetches all supported vehicle models for a specified vehicle make using the Toolbench RapidAPI.

make.description: The brand of the vehicle for which to fetch the models.

function.name: getstatsbyyear
function.description: Retrieves Trinidad & Tobago Covid-19 statistics by year.

is_id.description: The year for which the Covid-19 statistics are being requested. Must be between 2020 and the current year.

function.name: get_companies_by_sic_code
function.description: Retrieve a list of the top 100 companies related to a specified SIC code using the Toolbench RapidAPI service.

sic_code.description: The Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) code used to lookup companies.

function.name: get_transaction_v2
function.description: Fetches normalized transaction data from a specified blockchain using the provided transaction ID and API key.

blockchain.description: The name of the blockchain to query.

txid.description: The transaction ID for the desired transaction.
